notes.title: Save Aisha gets 8.8/10 from IGN Middle East
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38609864/21afc3103bb77bc6a79a1b9d3867051653b457f0.png[/img]


[b]Congratulations Fans! 
[/b]

We did it! [b]8.8 from IGN[/b], it's what any indie developer want. 

we love to share the review summary with you: 
"The appearance of this game does not suggest that it is beautiful and smooth in style of play, but it is really so, it will bring you great platform fun with a large number of carefully designed stages, it will be the most beautiful gift for a fan of challenging and difficult games, and it is really one of the best Arab projects so far"

To read the article in it's original language: 
https://me.ign.com/ar/mrj-save-aisha/145372/review/mrj-llb-lrby-save-aisha
